## 入学条件 {#admissions}

<p class="catalog-fact"><strong>A-level标准要求（概览）：</strong>BBC, where a student has three relevant subjects；本页还有科目及其他条件，完整条件本轮待逐条审校。</p>
<p class="fact-sources"><a href="#source-p-UKENR-0eb071d06af3fb">官方依据</a></p>

<p class="catalog-fact"><strong>IB标准要求：</strong>32 分 总分, with 5,5,5：HL, 包括 one of 数学, 物理, 或 化学. If 数学 is not studied：HL, then we would require SL 数学 with Grade 6 或 higher. We will accept 数学: Analysis及Approaches 或 数学: 数学AI. We do not consider the IB Career Related Programme (IBCP) for entry onto our Integrated Foundation 年 programme.</p>
<p class="fact-sources"><a href="#source-p-UKENR-0eb071d06af3fb">官方依据</a></p>

<p class="catalog-fact"><strong>英语要求（概览）：</strong>IELTS Academic 或 IELTS Academic UKVI 6.0 总分 with no sub-skill below 5.5. International students require an IELTS Academic UKVI if the Foundation 年 is taken as a stand-alone qualification,；本页还有科目及其他条件，完整条件本轮待逐条审校。</p>
<p class="fact-sources"><a href="#source-p-UKENR-0eb071d06af3fb">官方依据</a></p>

<p class="catalog-fact"><strong>面试要求：</strong>课程页提供面试及甄选安排；不同申请背景可能适用不同流程，本轮尚待将完整规则逐条整理。</p>
<p class="fact-sources"><a href="#source-p-UKENR-0eb071d06af3fb">官方依据</a></p>
